title: Goulden's Vanilla Backpack
description: My Vanilla-Style Backpack. Upgradeable and Dyeable!
body:
### **This mod adds a backpack, but not in a simple way, let me tell you why...** 👀
# 
### » Craft a backpack «
![the backpack recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8d2d157ecaf23abe0051a4b91a179c9bd3bc186.png)  
You can **craft** a backpack with this simple **recipe**.  
# 
### » Equip a backpack «
![player in front of a backpack with the instructions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60eae32a37f835dfc900c5bb65cf1728d8463914.png)
![chestplate slot with a cross on it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ab40c18df6b72a298e0378291ce6136871dddae_0.webp)  
Once you crafted it, **place it** on the ground and **Shift + Right-click** it with your **barehand** to **equip it**.  
To **unequip it**, just do the same but looking at the **ground**.  
_when equipped, it doesn't use any vanilla slot._  
# 
### » Dye a backpack «
![four backpack dyed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8fb4b51757d8e84903f68577169c7619594a8da.png)  
You can **dye** a backpack changing the dye that you **craft** it with or...  
by **Shift + Right-clicking** the backpack _base_ or _lid_ with a dye in your hand.  
_it supports modded dyes_
# 
### » Upgrade a backpack «
You can **upgrade** a backpack on **3** different ways:  
![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7c473f4dbf4177bbd7a10dcc7b917f9bd97e377.png)  
⇧_makes the backpack invulnerable to lava and explosions_ ⇖  
![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adb9ecc8d19951f7a5604d59bbc11539d325f89f.png)  
⇧_locks the backpack to other players when it is in your back, removable with shears_ ⇖  
![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9722165f9097a623f73aa1fe578cfcf613dd0a7c.png)  
⇧_increases the backpack storage capacity_ ⇖
